title: AW27 Men's Season Colour Analysis
summary: AW27 menswear colour: tinted black, greyed blue and copper khaki for tailoring and outerwear; dusky violet and tannic bordeaux for a younger customer.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Neutrals shift: grey toward greyish blue, khaki toward taupe, green or copper, navy toward turquoise or purplish tones<sup>[1]</sup>
- At Première Vision, deep violet, plums, dusty pinks, mauves and tinted off-blacks set the tone; violet is "centre stage", and plum and deep red become alternatives to black<sup>[1]</sup>
- Van den Hoek's menswear colour: sand, beige, brown and cognac, army to bright greens, grey as a base, and one bold accent<sup>[2]</sup>
- Forecut's AW27 colour forecast: violet, plum and tannic bordeaux replace black over tinted neutrals<sup>[3]</sup>

Confirm codes against a physical Pantone book before dyeing.

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** tinted black, greyed blue, copper khaki, mushroom.
- **Seasonal:** dusky violet, tannic bordeaux.
- **Accent:** sage, and one bold accent on a subdued base.

design_implications: - Lab-dip tinted black against true black.
commercial_implications: - Move part of the black and navy buy to tinted black and greyed blue.
